tunnel.passage_other_detail: Gray, featureless void/gray cloud; experiencer was unsure about a tunnel and described being 'just instantly in a gray, featureless void.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus: large, muscular, olive-skinned, long black curly hair; light-brown eyes with golden/amber hue; seated in a room/chamber and spoke aloud and telepathically. God: loud booming voice from a distant cloudlike radiant-light source, in an unknown 'language of God.'
arrival.other_being_detail: Deceased paternal grandparents ('Granny and Pappy') appeared youthful (late 20s), glowing/aura; later saw demonic beings torturing people in cages on a flying train-like vehicle.

environment.environment_other_detail: Heaven described with radiant colors (including colors 'that don't exist on earth'), towers of pure gold rising into clouds/out of sight; busy city-like activity with multitudes of people; a cloudlike radiant-light object; gray void; a floating convertible/gondola vehicle; a menacing flying 'train' with cage cars descending into a hole (hell-bound).

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Felt a need to share the experience and 'let people know there is an afterlife' and help others regain faith; also a specific corrective message from Jesus to appreciate natural beauty and thank God for it.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: T-boned car wreck with traumatic brain injury and lacerated temporal artery; severe blood loss; respirator used because he was not breathing on his own.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Strong Protestant Christian but 'not big into churchgoing.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hell-bound scene: flying train-like vehicle with cages and demonic torture; 'instant comprehension'; transport via floating gondola/convertible; golden double sliding doors/elevator-like descent to Jesus.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE at hospital gurney with verified detail; encounter with deceased grandparents; gray void and transport; hell-bound scene; arrival in heaven; voice of God from radiant cloudlike light; golden doors/elevator to chamber with Jesus; brief life review and judgment/teaching; cosmic vision (birth of universe); return to body in hospital bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Floating convertible/gondola transport in a gray void; a flying train pulling cage cars of people being tortured by demonic beings en route to hell; 'instant comprehension' by looking; God speaking in an unknown 'language of God'; elevator-like golden double sliding doors descending to Jesus; doctrinally atypical claim that people en route to hell could still be saved if remorseful; observation of diverse populations in heaven including non-Christians and gay people; reported post-NDE heightened hearing sensitivity.
unique_elements.notable_quotes:
'God and his son have been hugging and holding me all week long. Jesus Christ touched my scalp and healed it!'
'We're here to protect you!'
'You don't think I know who you are!?' 
'Your biggest and only sin is you don't appreciate the natural beauty in the world.'
